name: A Simmering Storm

angles.text: As a Horde adventurer, you help Rezlak secure mysterious magical artifacts recovered from hostile harpies threatening Durotar's canyons.
As a shaman, you recognize the miniature electrical storm as a reflection of primal elemental forces. Its crude vessel raises questions about the harpies' methods.
As an engineer, you share Rezlak's interest in odd curiosities that spark with erratic electrical charges and swirling internal mists.

faq.answer: The Dull Stormy Orb is a magical curiosity recovered from a harpy in Durotar. Its dull surface hides a faint electrical buzz, swirling dark mist, and occasional sparks.
faq.q: What is the Dull Stormy Orb?

faq.answer: Rezlak wants the Dull Stormy Orb. He is a goblin scout stationed just outside Drygulch Ravine in Durotar, with an eye for peculiar curiosities and salvage.
faq.q: Who wants the Dull Stormy Orb?

aliases: what were harpies doing with orb
why do harpies have storm orb
faq.answer: The harpies' purpose for the orb is unknown. The Dustwind harpies of Drygulch Ravine were using it to channel or contain electrical and stormy elemental forces.
faq.q: Why did the harpies have this orb?

faq.answer: Rezlak is a goblin operative near Drygulch Ravine in northern Durotar. He is affiliated with the Steamwheedle Cartel and Chief Engineer Gazlowe of Ratchet.
Drygulch Ravine is a rugged canyon system in northern Durotar. Hostile Dustwind harpies infest it, harassing travelers and disrupting local trade and settlements.

aliases: what does rezlak say about gazlowe
faq.answer: The orb brings to Rezlak's mind lessons and remarks from his boss, Chief Engineer Gazlowe, about peculiar oddities that might prove profitable.
faq.q: What does Rezlak think of the orb?

sections.body: Travelers who contend with the Dustwind harpies of Drygulch Ravine may find the Dull Stormy Orb among their strange trinkets. Its worn surface gives off a steady electrical vibration. Dark mist churns within, split now and then by sharp sparks. The relic shows the harpies have handled storm magic.
sections.title: A Spark in the Dust

sections.body: Rezlak waits at the entrance to Drygulch Ravine, where the orb has caught his eye. Its discovery brings to mind advice from his employer, Chief Engineer Gazlowe of Ratchet. What the harpies meant to do with the miniature storm remains unknown. Now the orb is in goblin hands.
sections.title: Goblin Curiosity

summary: In Durotar, the Dull Stormy Orb has caught Rezlak's attention. The goblin tinker sees reason to study the relic, recovered from the Dustwind harpies of Drygulch Ravine.
